messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — discovered a last-minute payload key rename in the console export for model metadata. 'model_version' -> 'mv'. This will affect API validation and the runtime metadata unpacker.

sasha: how widespread? runtime only or router/header mapping too?

maya: Console change got merged in staging earlier today. API schema now rejects requests with the old key (400). Runtime expects kv cache entries with 'model_version' string. Router just forwards JSON; but we do a header-based routing for version pins, so router unaffected unless we need a split based on that field.

raj: oof. Timeline? are we talking prod cutover in 30m?

maya: yes, cutover window in 45m. We should decide: hotfix API to accept both keys, or pin runtime to older model-unpack behavior, or delay cutover.

tim: Suggest dual-read in API for a short window: accept both 'mv' and 'model_version' and normalize to mv. Low-risk. Then runtime can be patched in next deploy.

maya: agree dual-read is safest. small patch to validations. Sasha, can console revert commit in staging?

sasha: I can revert but that would require console -> console-db migration revert. I'd rather do API accept both. I have a 1-line change.

raj: deploybot, can you queue a canary for API (service=redwood-api) and pin runtime to v1.9-compat on canary nodes? We want runtime serving old kv semantics until runtime patch lands.

deploy-bot: @raj acknowledged. Queuing canary deploy for redwood-api to 10% traffic. Command: `/deploy redwood-api --image=api:2026-03-22-mv-dualread --traffic=10% --notes="mv dual-read hotfix"`

ops-bot: FYI console and runtime teams need a heads-up. Also recommend holding router header-split until API canary is green.

maya: good point — hold router header-split. Sasha, can you push the API PR to staging now?

sasha: pushing in 2m. quick unit test added.

maya: sample validation snippet for API inbound normalizer:
```json
{"inbound": {
  "mv": "<string>",
  "model_version": "<string>" // fallback accept
}}
```
Normalization: prefer mv if present else model_version.

tim: runtime pin command ready: `/pin runtime --pool=canary --image=runtime:v1.9-compat --duration=2h`

raj: Do it. We'll monitor errors and token-metrics. If anything >1% 5xx in canary in 10m we abort.

deploy-bot: redwood-api canary deploy started — job 8942. Estimated completion 60s.

maya: Console team: do not push schema change to prod until we confirm canary + runtime pin.

ops-bot: Router split hold applied — manual gate set.

deploy-bot: canary complete: redwood-api @10% healthy. No errors for first 2m.

tim: runtime pin applied to canary pool. Confirmed nodes serving v1.9-compat.

raj: rolling canary to 25% for 10m. metrics: latency +2%, errors 0.1%. very low.

maya: good. sasha, any concerns about telemetry or logging mapping with dual keys? We need to make sure logs normalize to mv for downstream metrics.

sasha: added normalization in logging layer too. Should be fine.

raj: hold router header-split until we hit 25% stable for 10m and console keeps staging only. If stable, we'll do staged prod rollout: 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m checks.

ops-bot: added rollback hook: if 5xx > 1% or p95 latency regression >20% in any step, immediate rollback to previous image and unpin runtime.

maya: timeline looks safe. Plan: do not merge console schema into prod until after 100% API rollout and runtime patch. Console will leave the commit in staging and we will coordinate a follow-up runtime deploy to update kv semantics.

tim: agree. I'll prepare runtime patch branch (v2.0-kv-mv) and schedule after API reaches 100%.

deploy-bot: canary -> 25% -> 50% started. Step 50% will begin in ~12m.

raj: tagging release notes: add note "Temporary acceptance of legacy key 'model_version' during migration; runtime pinned to v1.9-compat in canary; console schema pending merge to prod."

maya: thanks all. keeping router split held. I'll post a final thread update when prod rollout completes. :white_check_mark:

tim: quick follow-up — if we see any KV-cache mismatch in runtime logs, set env DEBUG_KV_NORM=1 on canary nodes for extra traces.

maya: noted. Setting monitoring alerts for kv-mismatch logs and metric.

deploy-bot: prod rollout reached 100% at 1805012660. No rollback triggered.

maya: resolved — prod rollout completed, runtime patch scheduled for 2h from now, console will merge schema after runtime patch. Router header-split released after runtime patch. Great job everyone :tada:
